title: Cognitive amplification: harnessing artificial intelligence to augment metacognitive learning strategies
core_idea: Explore how artificial intelligence can act as 'cognitive amplification' to enhance metacognitive learning strategies—by delivering personalized feedback, schedules, and self-assessment tools—to support self-regulated and reflective learning, examined via qualitative study of learners' experiences to identify facilitators and barriers to AI integration in education.
tldr: The paper investigates AI as a means to amplify metacognitive strategies, using qualitative methods to study learner experiences and pinpoint factors that affect successful integration of AI supports in education.
